answer: When k coordinated identities equivocate, the protocol aggregates pairwise evidence and applies penalties proportional to k(k−1)/2, producing O(k²) loss rather than a linear per-key fee. If detection also triggers escalating haircuts across bonded escrows, a sybil swarm faces an exponential multiplier in total capital loss. An echoing orchard of keys cannot safely split one operator’s risk or raise its apparent influence to the zenith.
